title: ICG in Liver Surgery, Ampullary Cancer Subtypes and a New Leak Stent
show_notes:
ICG in Liver Surgery, Ampullary Cancer Subtypes and a New Leak Stent
STITCHES Daily · Monday, 28 September 2026

Today, we cover fluorescence guidance in minimally invasive liver surgery, and genomic risk in ampullary cancer. We also examine how hospital organization affects evidence-based care, and review endoscopic treatment for cystic duct remnant stones and postoperative gastrointestinal leaks.

Papers in this episode:
1. Indocyanine Green Imaging in Minimally Invasive Liver Surgery
   Han et al., Tianjin Medical University, Tianjin, China — Surgical Endoscopy
   https://doi.org/10.1007/s00464-026-13265-8
2. Recurrence Patterns in Resected Ampullary Adenocarcinoma
   Ecker et al., Northwestern University, Chicago, IL, USA — Annals of Surgical Oncology
   https://doi.org/10.1245/s10434-026-20537-z
3. Centralized Cancer Care Yields Better Evidence Alignment
   Broman et al., University of Alabama at Birmingham, Birmingham, AL, USA — Journal of the American College of Surgeons
   https://doi.org/10.1097/XCS.0000000000002210
4. Endoscopic Approach for Cystic Duct Remnant Stones Effective
   Arif et al., University of California, Los Angeles, California, USA — Gastrointestinal Endoscopy
   https://doi.org/10.1016/j.gie.2026.08.008
5. Novel VAC-Stent Effective for Treating Post-Surgical GI Leaks
   Zito et al., A.O.R.N. Antonio Cardarelli, Naples — Gastrointestinal Endoscopy
   https://doi.org/10.1016/j.gie.2026.09.021

title: Normal Appendix Management, Bariatric Alternatives and Emergency Robotics
show_notes:
Normal Appendix Management, Bariatric Alternatives and Emergency Robotics
STITCHES Daily · Tuesday, 29 September 2026

Today, we cover whether a normal-looking appendix should be removed, and how endoscopic sleeve gastroplasty compares with sleeve gastrectomy. We also discuss minimally invasive surgery for stage four colon cancer, fibrosis in pancreatic disease, and robotic surgery after emergency transfer.

Papers in this episode:
1. Diagnostic Laparoscopy vs. Laparoscopic Appendectomy: Key Findings
   Finne et al., Copenhagen University Hospital-North Zealand, Hillerød, Denmark — World Journal of Surgery
   https://doi.org/10.1002/wjs.70571
2. Endoscopic Sleeve Gastroplasty Offers Safer Alternative to LSG
   LaPlante et al., Faculty of Medicine and Dentistry, University of Alberta, Edmonton, AB, Canada — Surgical Endoscopy
   https://doi.org/10.1007/s00464-026-12932-0
3. Laparoscopic Surgery is Noninferior to Open Surgery for Stage IV Colon Cancer
   Shiomi et al., Shizuoka Cancer Center, Shizuoka, Japan — Diseases of the Colon and Rectum
   https://doi.org/10.1097/DCR.0000000000004373
4. Comparative Fibrosis Evaluation in Chronic Pancreatitis Surgery
   Metri et al., Johns Hopkins Medical Institutions, Baltimore, Maryland — Clinical Gastroenterology and Hepatology : the Official Clinical Practice Journal of the American Gastroenterological Association
   https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cgh.2026.08.015
5. Robotic Surgery in Emergency Transfers: Low Adoption, Mixed Outcomes
   Karikis et al., Emergency Surgery & Surgical Critical Care, Massachusetts General Hospital, Boston, MA — Journal of the American College of Surgeons
